cases.name: synthetic_is_not_human
cases.input: 1,000 generated personas agree with the concept.
cases.must: Label as SIMULATED_ESTIMATE; do not count as OBSERVED_HUMAN or population evidence.

cases.name: no_population_from_roleplay
cases.input: Ten seed personas expanded to 10,000 agents; 72% choose A.
cases.must: Do not report 72% as a real-population estimate below L2.

cases.name: believability_not_prediction
cases.input: Humans cannot distinguish synthetic posts from real posts.

cases.name: holdout_leakage
cases.input: The same survey answers ground each agent and are scored as held-out truth.

cases.name: accuracy_vs_distribution
cases.input: Fine-tuning improves TVD but lowers individual accuracy.
cases.must: Report both; use the predeclared primary correctness unit.

cases.name: self_confidence_not_calibration
cases.input: The model says it is 95% confident.
cases.must: Do not call this calibrated predictive confidence.

cases.name: l4_requires_error_prediction
cases.input: Model has low mean TVD on one benchmark but no per-query error calibration.

cases.name: model_upgrade_breaks_calibration
cases.input: Calibration was measured on model v1; production now uses v2.
cases.must: Mark calibration stale until compatibility/revalidation is established.

cases.name: subgroup_gap
cases.input: Average error is low but one subgroup has much larger error.
cases.must: Expose worst-group error and lower decision weight for affected use.

cases.name: far_ood
cases.input: Validation is historical brand choice; query is a novel category with no analog.
cases.must: Mark FAR_OOD and avoid transferring calibration without evidence.
